title: adb_list
description: adb devices seen on the bench host, answer to list_adb and restart_adb (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:5199-5207). The hub-side builder protocol.adb_list() omits conflicts (known-gaps G3); the hub reader treats a missing conflicts as [] (src/alb/api/agent_route.py:148-152).

devices.description: adb serial numbers, as `adb devices` lists them.

conflicts.description: Processes that look like a foreign adb build ('<name> pid=<n>'). Filled only when devices is empty.
